name: popsicle
headline: AI-Powered Blog Automation with N8N
short_description: Automate your blogging process with the AI-Powered Blog Automation Suite. This complete N8N workflow streamlines content creation, research, SEO optimization, and publishing to Ghost CMS, enhancing productivity and efficiency.
author: christancho

sections.overview:
Blogging with N8N is a comprehensive automation system that orchestrates multiple specialized AI agents to transform topic requests into fully published, SEO-optimized blog posts. The workflow handles research, table of contents creation, content generation with citations, SEO optimization, editing, and direct publication to Ghost CMS—reducing content creation time from hours to minutes. Each agent specializes in a specific role: research, content writing, keyword optimization, quality assurance, and HTML publishing. The system uses high-throughput AI models (200k TPM recommended) to handle agent interactions without rate limiting. Built-in quality control gates and approval steps ensure consistency and maintain brand voice throughout the publishing process.
Automate blog post creation
Optimize content for SEO
Schedule and publish posts to Ghost CMS
Conduct research for blog topics
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
